chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated; he said: Al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿUlwān narrated to us, from ʿAmr ibn Thābit, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said to ʿAlī عليه السلام: “O ʿAlī, I counsel you regarding traits for yourself, so preserve them.” Then he said: “O Allah, help him.

As for the first, it is truthfulness, and never let a lie ever come out of your mouth. The second is waraʿ, such that you never dare commit betrayal. The third is fear of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, as though you see Him. The fourth is abundant weeping out of fear of Allah, Mighty and Majestic; with every tear, a house will be built for you in Paradise. The fifth is to give your wealth and your blood for the sake of your religion. The sixth is to follow my sunnah in my salat, my fasting, and my charity. As for the salat, it is fifty rakʿahs. As for fasting, it is three days in every month: a Thursday in its beginning, a Wednesday in its middle, and a Thursday in its end. As for charity, it is your utmost effort, until you say: I have been excessive, though you have not been excessive. And adhere to the night prayer, and adhere to the night prayer, and adhere to the night prayer. And adhere to the salat of zawāl. And adhere to recitation of the Qur'an in every state. And adhere to raising your hands in the salat and turning them both. And adhere to the siwāk at every wudu for every salat. And adhere to the noble traits of character, so adopt them; and the blameworthy ones, so avoid them.
For if you do not do that, then blame none but yourself.”

key_terms.السِّوَاكِ: the tooth-stick used for oral cleansing before worship
key_terms.الصِّدْقُ: truthfulness; speaking only what is true
key_terms.الْوَرَعُ: scrupulous piety and restraint from doubtful or sinful matters
key_terms.تِلَاوَةِ الْقُرْآنِ: recitation of the Qur'an regularly and in all states
key_terms.خَشْيَةِ اللَّهِ: reverent fear of Allah that produces humility and tears
key_terms.صَلَاةِ الزَّوَالِ: the prayer associated with the time of midday decline
key_terms.صَلَاةِ اللَّيْلِ: the night prayer emphasized repeatedly in the hadith
key_terms.مَحَاسِنِ الْأَخْلَاقِ: excellent moral qualities to be adopted

ai.seo_question: What qualities and acts of worship did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله advise Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام to uphold?
ai.summary: This hadith records the Prophet’s صلى الله عليه وآله counsel to Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, gathering core virtues of personal piety, moral discipline, and devotional practice. It joins ethical qualities such as truthfulness, waraʿ, and noble character with acts of worship like salat, fasting, charity, night prayer, Qur'an recitation, and siwāk, while also emphasizing fear of Allah and reward in Paradise.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.5432 - Al-Husayn ibn Saʿid narrated that Al-Husayn ibn Ulwan reported from Amr ibn Thabit from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said to Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as):
"O' Ali (as), I advise you regarding certain traits concerning yourself, so preserve them."
Then Prophet (sw) said: "O' Allah (swt), assist him!
Seek truthfulness - never let a lie leave your mouth.
And seek Piety - never allow yourself to commit a betrayal.
And seek Fear of Allah (swt), the Almighty and Majestic - as if you see Him (swt).
And seek Abundant weeping from the fear of Allah (swt), the Almighty and Majestic - for every tear shed, a house will be built for you in Paradise.
And seek Sacrificing your wealth and blood in defense of your religion.
And seek Adhering to my tradition in prayer, fasting, and charity.
As for prayer, it is fifty rak'ahs.
As for fasting, it is three days in every month; a Thursday at the beginning (of the month), a Wednesday in the middle, and a Thursday at the end (of the month).
As for charity, it should be given to your utmost ability until you say, 'I have gone to excess,' though you will not have gone to excess.
You must uphold the night prayer, you must uphold the night prayer, you must uphold the night prayer.
You must uphold the midday prayer (Salat Al-Zawal).
You must recite the Quran in all conditions.
You must raise your hands in prayer and move them in supplication.
You must use the siwak (tooth-stick) before every ablution and before every prayer.
You must adopt good morals - embrace them.
You must avoid bad morals - stay away from them.
If you fail to do so, then blame none but yourself."
